source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: When Canis Rex is **destroyed**, resolve the arrival of Sir Hekhtur by Emergency Disembarkation as from a destroyed **TRANSPORT**. No Stratagem can target Sir Hekhtur. For destruction accounting, Canis Rex remains in play while Sir Hekhtur survives.

replacement.arrival: Emergency Disembarkation as from a destroyed TRANSPORT

detail.restriction: Sir Hekhtur cannot be targeted by Stratagems
